single-cluster.description: One cluster at a time on container-local sparse BlueStore, tests run sequentially
single-cluster.basis: Memory is the VM size the suite is sized for (docs/contributing/testing.md). CPUs are those of the hosted CI runner; fewer were not measured. Disk is the 8 GiB image-preparation allowance plus the 4 GiB runtime allowance of the smallest qualified CI storage profile (docs/contributing/ci.md).

in-memory-osds.description: One cluster of up to three 1 GiB WithInMemory (tmpfs) BlueStore OSDs
in-memory-osds.basis: single-cluster plus 3 GiB for three fully allocated 1 GiB tmpfs stores, rounded up to the next common VM size. An arithmetic bound, not a measured peak.

ci-parity.description: A CI batch as CI runs it: two tests at once (CEPH_TEST_PARALLEL=2), multicluster fixtures included
ci-parity.basis: The size of the hosted CI runner and the largest qualified CI storage profile, 8 GiB image preparation plus 8 GiB runtime (docs/contributing/ci.md). Kernel features are those of the network fault, capture and block fault tests that ordinary batches run.

block-fault-delay.description: single-cluster plus the loop and device-mapper pieces of the block fault test, its delay window included
block-fault-delay.basis: single-cluster. The fault/blockio keeper, a blockio.HelperImage container, builds a loop device and device-mapper linear, error and delay tables on the engine host.

network-faults.description: single-cluster plus packet delay, loss and rate faults, with peer selection
network-faults.basis: single-cluster. fault.ApplyNetworkProfile installs a netem qdisc, and with peers a prio qdisc and u32 filters.

encrypted-osd.description: single-cluster plus an OSD on a test-owned LUKS2 dm-crypt store
encrypted-osd.basis: single-cluster. The osd_encrypted_store batch reads the registered device-mapper targets and needs crypt.

cephfs-fuse.description: single-cluster plus ceph-fuse mounts in client containers
cephfs-fuse.basis: single-cluster. The cephfs_fuse batch mounts through /dev/fuse.

rbd-nbd.description: single-cluster plus an RBD image mapped as a block device by rbd-nbd (librbd in user space)
rbd-nbd.basis: single-cluster. TestDesktopRBDOverNBD needs the nbd driver and /dev/nbd nodes; librbd and rbd-nbd come from the official Ceph image.

kernel-clients.description: single-cluster plus the Ceph kernel clients: krbd (rbd over libceph) and the kernel CephFS client
kernel-clients.basis: single-cluster. The kernel subtest of the cephfs_fscrypt experiment needs the ceph filesystem type; no fixture maps an image through krbd.
